interactables.name: Welcome Placard
interactables.text: WHISKER ACADEMY - HALL OF BASICS.|A placard in a white room. It reads: 'Walk with WASD or the arrow keys. Stand near a thing. Press Enter to inspect it.'|Below, in smaller print: 'Words that light up are CLUES. They file themselves in your journal. Tonight's exercise: something tipped the saucer on [the training floor]. Work out what happened.'

interactables.name: Tipped Saucer
interactables.text: A [tipped saucer], flat on its back. The milk is a thin white lake with no survivors.|Tiny wet paw prints leave the lake in three tight circles, then rocket toward nothing in particular. That is not walking. That is [the zoomies].

interactables.name: The Kitten
interactables.text: A very small cat sits in the middle of the white room, looking extremely innocent. Nobody looks that innocent by accident.|A placard beside her reads: 'Some witnesses have more to say. Choose an action from the menu. You do not talk. You act.'

topics.text: She holds very still, the way the guilty and the polite both do. Her whiskers smell like fresh milk and bad decisions. [The kitten] has been somewhere milky tonight.

topics.prompt: Stare at her until someone blinks.
topics.text: You blink first. Unheard of. She is either innocent or a professional.|At [3:00 AM], kittens are neither. They are something else entirely.

You did the deduction. She knows you know.|She flops over, shows her belly, and squeaks once. In cat, that is a full confession, a plea bargain, and a request for snacks, all at the same time.|A new placard rises from the floor: 'CONFRONTATION COMPLETE. Some talks only unlock after a SOLVE. Hear them all, or the final board stays shut.'

interactables.name: The Old Dog
interactables.text: [The old dog] is asleep on the only rug in the void. His placard reads: 'Every mystery needs more than one suspect. Otherwise it is just an accusation.'

topics.text: One eye opens. It has seen empires fall. It closes again.|His stomach growls like distant thunder. If [hunger] ever moves him, it has not managed it tonight.

interactables.name: Water Bowl
interactables.text: A [water bowl], upright, full, entirely blameless. Not everything you find is the answer. Write it down anyway.

interactables.name: Board Placard
interactables.text: 'When you have clues, press SOLVE in the bottom-right corner - it pulses gold when the room is complete. Click a slot, click a clue from the tabs, click INSERT. Wrong guesses cost nothing but pride.'|'Solve this room. Then take the doorway east - the chevron marks the way.'

localDeductionSentence: [The kitten] tipped over [the saucer] because of [the zoomies].
